## Use case

What problem are you trying to solve? Identify the affected dimension, package,
or workflow and any relevant constraints.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the desired API or result. A small example problem and expected output
help explain the change. For a new algorithm, link its primary reference and
describe the expected packing-quality or performance benefit.

## Alternatives

Describe existing options you tried and why they do not meet the need.

## Compatibility and scope

Note any expected effects on serialization, feature flags, language bindings,
runtime, or memory use. Include constraints on backward compatibility, if known.
